mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys11_relate_file WHERE sys11_file_id = #{fileId} AND sys11_parent_id != #{parentId} AND sys11_parent_id IN ( SELECT apr01_appr_id FROM apr01_appr WHERE apr01_appr_id = sys11_parent_id AND apr01_status_cd != '99' UNION ALL SELECT apr99_appr_id FROM apr99_appr_del WHERE apr99_appr_id = sys11_parent_id AND apr99_status_cd != '99' )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys11_relate_file r WHERE r.sys11_file_id = #{fileId} AND r.sys11_parent_id != #{parentId} AND ( r.sys11_parent_table IS NULL OR (r.sys11_parent_table = 'ics01_class_tree' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ics01_class_tree WHERE ics01_class_tree_id = r.sys11_parent_id)) OR (r.sys11_parent_table = 'tdm43_manl' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tdm43_manl WHERE tdm43_manl_id = r.sys11_parent_id)) OR (r.sys11_parent_table = 'apr01_appr' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM apr01_appr WHERE apr01_appr_id = r.sys11_parent_id)) OR r.sys11_parent_table NOT IN ('ics01_class_tree', 'tdm43_manl', 'apr01_appr') )
